content.body: Since GitHub is part of Microsoft nowadays, can Microsoft folks get https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/192705 to their attention?
I'll see what I can do.
Can unblock by switching to semantic linebreaks to get reasonable line lengths, but that means we can't reformat completely automatedly.

(I've been meaning for a few years to explore using a small line-breaking model to automate that; someone did this work themselves a while ago and I've never had the time to properly evaluate using it on specs.)
